map.修剪时间窗按植物与季节确定：月季冬季休眠期（12 月至 2 月）重剪、花后轻剪残: Pruning windows are set by plant and season: roses are hard pruned in winter dormancy (December to February) and lightly pruned after flowering to remove spent blooms; fruit trees get shaping pruning in winter and thinning plus tip pinching in summer; evergreen shrubs are pruned before spring bud break; flowering shrubs are pruned after flowering so flower buds are not removed; the principle is to prune the framework in winter and the branches in summer, cutting about 0.5 cm above a bud at a 45 degree angle so it heals well.
map.修剪工具需锋利并消毒，避免伤口感染: Pruning tools must be sharp and disinfected to avoid infecting the wound
map.斜剪45度，剪口距芽点上方约0.5cm: Cut at 45 degrees, about 0.5 cm above the bud
map.先剪枯枝、病枝、交叉枝，再修剪造型: Remove dead, diseased and crossing branches first, then shape
map.开花植物在花后修剪，避免剪掉花芽: Prune flowering plants after flowering so flower buds are not removed
map.大伤口涂抹愈合剂，防止水分流失和病害: Apply wound dressing to large cuts to prevent water loss and disease
map.雨天不宜修剪，湿度大易滋生病菌: Avoid pruning in the rain, since the humidity encourages pathogens

map.区分当年新枝开花与老枝开花的植物，确定修剪窗口。: Distinguish plants that bloom on new wood from those that bloom on old wood to determine the pruning window.
map.按季节给出 best（最适宜）/ok（可以）/avoid（避免）三档。典型时机：: Three tiers by season: best, ok and avoid. Typical timing: roses hard pruned before spring bud break and spent blooms removed after flowering for a second flush; osmanthus pruned in winter dormancy and avoided for hard pruning in summer; crape myrtle hard pruned in winter on one-year-old wood with spring bud pinching; hydrangea pruned from late August to September (old-wood bloomers cut right after flowering); camellia pruned in spring after flowering and not during autumn flower bud differentiation; bougainvillea hard pruned for shape at late winter and early spring; pomegranate pruned before spring bud break; grapevines pruned in winter dormancy.
map.查询“绣球花”：春 avoid、夏 ok、秋 best、冬 ok，最佳修剪期为秋: Looking up hydrangea: spring avoid, summer ok, autumn best, winter ok, with the best pruning window in late August to September, because it blooms on old wood and a hard spring prune would remove flower buds already formed, leaving no flowers that year. Looking up rose: spring and autumn best, winter and summer ok, and it can be pruned several times.
map.为什么有些植物秋季不能剪？: Why can some plants not be pruned in autumn?
map.茶花等秋季正处于花芽分化期，此时修剪会直接剪除来年花芽；应等花谢后的春季再整形。: Camellias and the like are in their flower bud differentiation period in autumn, and pruning then cuts away next year's buds directly; wait until spring after the flowers fade to shape them.
map.best 和 ok 怎么选？: How do I choose between best and ok?
map.best 表示该季节修剪最有利于开花或恢复；ok 表示可以轻剪或整形但效果一般；: best means pruning in that season is most favorable to flowering or recovery; ok means light pruning or shaping is possible with modest results; avoid means pruning will clearly affect flowering or overwintering, so it is best to steer clear.
